feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 22 October 2026 5:46am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds later.


##Wind)##

W or NW 4 occasionally 5 at first, backing S or SW 3 or 4 in the afternoon. Then backing E or NE 5 or 6 overnight into Friday.


##State of sea)##

Slight, becoming mainly moderate later.


##Weather)##

Fair, then heavy rain overnight.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain later.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 12°C
##Sea Temperature##

14°C
##Tomorrow##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds, gales for time.


##Wind)##

NE 5 or 6, occasionally 7 in the south of the area, backing NW 6 to gale 8. Decreasing W or NW 5 or 6 early Friday night, then W or SW 4 or 5 for a time, before increasing SW 5 or 6.


##State of sea)##

Mainly moderate, building moderate or rough through the morning, then decreasing slight or moderate overnight.


##Weather)##

Heavy rain clearing to isolated showers in the afternoon.


##Visibility)##

Moderate or poor, becoming good.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 12°C
##Sea Temperature##

14°C
##Saturday, 24 October 2026##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds and gales. Severe gales overnight.


##Wind)##

SW or S 5 or 6, increasing 6 to gale 8 through the morning, veering W or SW gale 8 or severe gale 9 through the evening and overnight.


##State of sea)##

Mainly moderate, soon becoming rough, then rough or very rough later.


##Weather)##

Heavy rain soon arriving, clearing to isolated showers in the evening.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 15°C
##Sea Temperature##

14°C
##Sunday, 25 October 2026##


##Warnings)##

Gales, occasional severe gales at first, decreasing to strong winds later.


##Wind)##

W 7 or gale 8, occasionally severe gale 9 at first, gradually decreasing 6 or 7 by late afternoon. Then backing SW 5 or 6 early in the night, before decreasing S 4 or 5 later.


##State of sea)##

Rough, occasionally very rough at first, then slight or moderate overnight.


##Weather)##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility)##

Good, occasionally moderate in any showers.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 12°C
##Sea Temperature##

14°C
##Monday, 26 October 2026##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds, gales later.


##Wind)##

S or SE 4 or 5, veering SW 6 to gale 8.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate, becoming moderate or rough.


##Weather)##

Outbreaks of rain, then showers later.


##Visibility)##

Good, occasionally poor in rain.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 15°C
##Sea Temperature##

14°C
